name: Eufy Security WS
short_desc: WebSocket server for Eufy Security devices
author: bropat
description: eufy-security-ws is a small server wrapper around the eufy-security-client library that exposes Eufy Security devices (cameras, doorbells, sensors, base stations) over a WebSocket API. It is the backend used by the Home Assistant eufy-security integration and similar clients. It has no web UI — clients connect to the WebSocket on port 3000. For camera live streaming (RTSP/WebRTC) the eufy_security integration also needs go2rtc; install the separate 'go2rtc' app from this store.

form_fields.hint: Password for the Eufy account above.

form_fields.hint: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. US, DE, GB.

form_fields.label: Trusted device name
form_fields.hint: Name shown in the Eufy app for this client.
